raw:
Pedro de la Rosa's only confirmed race-weekend teammate who went on to win a drivers' championship in 2000-2025 is Kimi Räikkönen.

- **Kimi Räikkönen:** In the 2006 Brazilian Grand Prix, de la Rosa and Räikkönen both drove for McLaren, so they were teammates. Räikkönen won the 2007 drivers' championship.
- **Others checked, no title:** At Arrows (2000) his teammate was Jos Verstappen, who did not win a title. At Sauber (2010) his teammates included Kamui Kobayashi and Nick Heidfeld, neither a champion. At Arrows in the 2000 races, and for other 2000-2025 seasons I did not find a race teammate who won a title.
- **Limits of the search:** The results were partial. I did not retrieve full season lineups for all of de la Rosa's years, and I did not find evidence of him racing alongside Jenson Button or Lewis Hamilton. So the list could be incomplete, but nothing I found points to another champion.

ANSWER: Kimi Räikkönen
